description:
After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer.
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation.
This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK.
If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated.
If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ClaimHandling"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkClaimStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendClaimBack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_HandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_Examine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_Examine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" name="Continue or repeat recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Mark</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkClaimStatus" name="Mark claim as OK or Not OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Mark</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Mark_Status</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimStatus" name="Claim status">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Mark_Status</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status_NotOK</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status_OK</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendClaimBack" name="Send claim back to claims officer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status_NotOK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_HandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status_OK</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_Examine" sourceRef="Event_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Write_Check" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Mark" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Task_MarkClaimStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mark_Status" sourceRef="Task_MarkClaimStatus" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_NotOK" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Task_SendClaimBack">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_OK" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Event_HandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_RecommendationMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendClaimBack" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendationMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
